Tell me about the OER microgrant info session

Here's the full picture on the *UVA Library OER Microgrant Program* info session:

*What it's about*
This is an information session on UVA Library's OER (Open Educational Resources) Microgrant Program, presented by Bethany Mickel and Judy Thomas. It's aimed at potential applicants or anyone interested in learning more.

The program funds small projects that:
• Advance the use, improvement, and adoption of open educational resources (OER)
• Support development of open teaching practices at UVA
• Encourage experimentation and reduce barriers to participation in open education
• Generate openly shared resources benefiting both UVA students and the broader educational community

*Logistics*
• Format: Online via Zoom
• Duration: 45 minutes
• Calendar: Faculty Programs
• Registration: Required (via the event page)

*Session dates* (repeats several times this summer/fall)
• Today, Fri 7/31, 12:00–12:45 PM — <https://cal.lib.virginia.edu/event/16873310|Register>

Contact Judy Thomas (jet3h) or Bethany Mickel (bbm9u) directly to arrange a consultation.

*More info*
<https://guides.lib.virginia.edu/oer/grant-opportunities|OER Grant Opportunities guide>

Doug will share his explorations developing a library-specific Model Context Protocol (MCP) for search and discovery.
